OrderController.__init__.summary: Wires the controller to its OrderService dependency (constructor injection).

OrderService.__init__.summary: Stores the injected OrderRepository and PaymentClient used to place and look up orders.

getOrder.summary: Frontend API client: GET /orders/:id and return the parsed order JSON.

loadOrder.summary: Frontend page action: loads an order by id via the API client.

submitOrder.summary: Frontend page action: submits a new order form via the API client.
